notes.title: 🍑🌴 Patch Notes for the Sauciest Sandbox on Steam 🍹🚤
notes.notes:
Hello sun-kissed deviants!

We’ve been busy rubbing sunscreen on bugs and giving your tropical getaway the explicit attention it deserves. Here’s what’s hot, fixed, and totally inappropriate in today’s update:
[hr][/hr]👙 Bug Fixes (Because even paradise has wardrobe malfunctions):
Fixed an issue with the male genitals when wearing bottom cloth or dress — because nothing says immersion like genitals behaving themselves under a nice sundress.

Fixed an issue with resetting of the hair, masks, blindfolds and glasses when making other changes in the character settings menu. Your kinky accessories should now stay where you put them.

Fixed an issue with the showing and hiding "Follow me" menu for the dog — the pup was feeling clingy AND shy, but we gave it a motivational bark.

Fixed an issue with appearing R(Shit) menu even when the player is not close to it — because surprise poop menus were never on anyone’s bucket list.

Fixed an issue with flying Fan boat after player gets out of it — no more airborne escape vessels taking off without you. This isn’t Fast & Furious: Sex Drift Edition.

Fixed an issue with wrong name of the Shit when you are popping — no more mysterious labels during your bowel adventures. It’s called what it is.

Fixed an issue with the long texts of the quest to get out from the quest message box — epic quests are cool, but now they actually fit inside the box.

Fixed an issue with the long texts of the message chat box — your spicy chat lines won’t spill out like beachside margaritas anymore.

Fixed an issue with crouching player when sliding — accidental crab-walking is now a thing of the past.

Fixed an issue with the sliding passenger on the Jet Sky — your plus-one won't be slip-sliding away like a bar of soap in the shower.

Fixed an issue with the wrong position and rotation of passenger in the car in multiplayer — no more exorcist-level neck twisting or floating passengers. Everyone sits (mostly) like a human now.
[hr][/hr]🔊 New Voice Content That Moans... We Mean Matters:
Added bundles of 10 extra-spicy, NSFW-leaning in-game voice lines for various actions and item pickups, including:
"Ball, Photo Camera, Flashlight, Life Ring, Plumber, Shit, Skeleton Head, Swimming Ring, Fire Torch, Porn Magazine, and Dildo."
Yes. All of those now talk to you. You're welcome.

Also added new voiced reactions for:
"sitting down, standing up, lying down, getting up from lying down, sitting on the toilet, and standing up from the toilet."
Because in this game, even your butt has a voice.
[hr][/hr]
Enjoy the improvements, test responsibly (or don’t), and remember: every patch brings us one step closer to the ultimate sun-drenched, sex-infused simulation of beachside debauchery.

Now go grab your... Flashlight.

With love and SPF 69,
—Your overcaffeinated dev in swim trunks

notes.title: 🧥 Fashion Overload & Multiplayer Mayhem – New Update!
notes.notes:
Hey stylish adventurers!

Big wardrobe news – your virtual closet just got a serious upgrade! Here's what’s hot off the runway:

👚 Dress to Impress

    Added 4 fabulous new collars. Because necks deserve attention too.

    Dumped a whole truckload of new clothes into your wardrobe. Now you really have nothing to wear!

    You can finally change clothing colors – no more blaming the game for that clashing outfit. Now it’s all on you!

🏃 Wardrobe Malfunctions Fixed

    Fixed that awkward thing where clothes would break when you ran too fast. You’re not the Hulk – your outfit should stay on.

🌐 Multiplayer Shenanigans Tamed

    Tweaked and tuned multiplayer. Fewer bugs, less weirdness, more fun.

    Your friends might still act strange, but the game won’t.

Thanks for playing and strutting your stuff!
Got fashion tips or bug reports? Drop them in the community – we’re listening (and judging your outfits lovingly 💅).

notes.title: Long awaited update
notes.notes:
Three months ago I decided that I can easily update the Unreal version of to the project to 5.4 and it will take me about a few days to catch and fix all bugs...
Well, passed three months, and, yes I updated the project version to 5.4, but...I had to create almost everything from the scratch. Except it, I added a lot of new functions and intractable objects. I guess that it may cause some bugs, so in the next few days (I hope) I will catch and fix all of them.
I would like to thank to everyone who report me bugs, problems and suggestions, as you really help to make this game better.
